=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:586-602 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: If a prior poll cycle is interrupted after adding the activation-verification worktree but before removing it, the next cycle removes its directory but leaves the worktree registration, so `git worktree add` fails on every subsequent cycle.
  WHY: A single interrupted cycle permanently disables activation verification for the affected project; the other completion paths continue and `set_tracking_phase_label "ai:merged"` runs regardless.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:156 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[2]
  PROBLEM: With more than 30 open operator-step issues, pagination can omit the oldest canonical issue that `find_issue` selects, causing the script to create duplicate issues on repeated invocations.
  WHY: GitHub lists issues newest-first, so the canonical issue can be on page 2 while the script only fetches the first 30; the duplicates can leave the upstream pipeline unable to identify the source of truth and may cause double-posting.
- scripts/operator_step_issue.py:73
  PROBLEM: `_clean` strips HTML comment delimiters through substring replacement, which can leave truncated operator-step instructions when comment-like text is present.
  WHY: An operator may see instructions with content silently omitted.
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:586-591
  PROBLEM: The worktree create path does not prune stale registrations before `git worktree add`.
  WHY: A stale registration from a crashed prior cycle can cause the worktree add to fail.
  SUGGESTED MINIMAL FIX: Call `git worktree prune 2>/dev/null || true` after `rm -rf "${verify_dir}"` and before the `git fetch` line.
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 3
- tests/test_activation_verify.py:78-96
  PROBLEM: The `_verify` helper always sets `LINKED_ISSUE="7"`, so the no-linked-issue fallback path in `activation_verify.sh` is not tested.
  WHY: A regression in the fallback path would only be caught by manual runs.
  SUGGESTED MINIMAL FIX: Add an `env_extra` variant with `LINKED_ISSUE=""` and assert that `verdict_comment["endpoint"] == "repos/o/r/issues/42/comments"` (post on the PR itself).
  HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
